svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: One login, one API, one Supabase database. Two features, and every AI output passes a check before it counts.
The AI never writes a status.
VAT ID format and checksum; line items add up to total (±0.01)
Duplicate invoice (vendor, number, total, date); missing fields
Amount threshold (per brief); GL account from gl_catalog only
Invoices: invoices, line_items, gl_catalog, rule results, audit_log
Each extracted number and date must appear in the OCR text.
A mismatch flags the field, and the invoice cannot be READY.
Every decision is saved with who, when and why.
